name: On-Chain Market Intelligence Pipeline
description: A crypto market regime engine combining macro liquidity, capital flow, on-chain behavior, narrative rotation, and explainable rule logic.
howItWorks: The pipeline ingests market and on-chain indicators, assigns transparent votes to each layer, then produces a regime report with confidence, drivers, probabilities, and source coverage.
whyItMatters: Markets are easier to reason about when signals are grouped into regimes instead of treated as isolated price movements.
whatILearned: Explainability matters as much as signal design; weak data sources need to be visible, not hidden behind confident language.
limitations: Some live inputs depend on API keys or proxy data. Scenario probabilities are heuristic and not calibrated forecasts.

name: Market Valuation Engine
description: A Yahoo Finance market commentary system for reading liquidity, sector rotation, quality rerating, valuation stretch, and chase risk.
howItWorks: The model evaluates macro regime, sector relative strength, company quality proxies, valuation stretch, and crowding signals before forming a narrative market-structure read.
whyItMatters: It turns market noise into a layered explanation of where capital is moving and where risk may be building.
whatILearned: A useful research tool should separate signal, narrative, and action instead of pretending every insight is a trade.
limitations: Some macro inputs need external data feeds. Outputs are research commentary, not buy or sell recommendations.

name: KOSPI Signal Monitor
description: An econometric research interface testing relationships between the KOSPI Composite and proxies such as semiconductors, FX, consumer stocks, K-pop agencies, and exports.
howItWorks: The backend pulls market proxies, runs descriptive econometric tests, scores candidate signals, and serves a browser-based analytical interface.
whyItMatters: Korean markets are connected to semiconductors, currency, exports, and culture; this tool tests those relationships in one place.
whatILearned: Statistical significance needs humility, especially when many signals are screened at once.
limitations: Results are descriptive, not causal proof. Optional foreign-flow and customs data require local credentials.

name: Hybrid Financial + Personal Intelligence OS
description: A Telegram-based intelligence assistant for regional news, market signals, watchlists, valuation commands, research briefs, and local Codex/Chrome automation.
howItWorks: Commands route through lightweight services that summarize inboxes, markets, regional news, watchlists, and local workspace tools.
whyItMatters: It explores how daily intelligence can be delivered through a familiar command surface rather than a separate application layer.
whatILearned: Cloud-safe and local-only capabilities need explicit boundaries when personal data and automation are involved.
limitations: Many features require private API keys and local runtime configuration, so the lab demo uses simulated command output.

name: SGD-NEER Shadow Model
description: A transparent shadow proxy for studying Singapore dollar exchange-rate policy through a trade-weighted geometric SGD index.
howItWorks: The script builds a weighted basket of observable SGD crosses, estimates a policy center and band, then saves an analytical view of the proxy path.
whyItMatters: Singapore's exchange-rate framework is policy-rich but opaque, making a transparent proxy useful for learning.
whatILearned: Good modeling sometimes means clearly stating what cannot be known.
limitations: MAS does not disclose the official basket, weights, center, slope, or band width.

name: Crypto Treasury Company Valuation Model
description: A decision-support tool for evaluating crypto treasury companies through NAV, yield, premium or discount, and mispricing signals.
howItWorks: The model compares market price with crypto asset value and yield assumptions to classify whether a treasury company offers an edge.
whyItMatters: Crypto exposure through equities can look simple while hiding premiums, discounts, and company-specific risk.
whatILearned: Valuation discipline matters most when the asset narrative is loud.
limitations: It excludes sentiment, macro conditions, and many company-specific risks.

name: Phone Cycle Timing Engine
description: A depreciation scenario tool that estimates when to buy, hold, or sell a phone based on price decay, timing, and release-cycle shocks.
howItWorks: Users adjust assumptions about current price, depreciation, and release timing; the app projects buy, hold, and sell windows.
whyItMatters: Small consumer decisions also have timing, depreciation, and opportunity-cost dynamics.
whatILearned: A simple model can be useful when the assumptions are visible and user-controlled.
limitations: Prices are estimated from assumptions rather than live resale data.

name: Demand Discovery Engine
description: A 72-hour business validation interface for exploring market demand, evidence, and opportunity signals.
howItWorks: The app uses a Next.js interface and AI-backed agent modules to organize validation evidence and business hypotheses.
whyItMatters: Fast validation helps separate real demand from interesting but unsupported ideas.
whatILearned: Business research tools need structure as much as generative output.
limitations: No GitHub remote was found from the workspace. AI features depend on API configuration.
